verdict.rationale: The Marketing API documents creating a contact in an audience (mailchimp-docs-4) and syncing custom data from your app (mailchimp-docs-1). Suppression is only loosely evidenced through the Transactional API's rejection allowlist/denylist (mailchimp-docs-17), and subscription-change webhooks (mailchimp-docs-19) are tangential. Missing for 10: documented contact update endpoints, explicit custom property/merge-field handling, Marketing-audience suppression/unsubscribe via API, and batch operations, rate limits or other production-scale evidence.
